segments.contextBefore: Ensure consistent, smooth rendering by profiling your app’s frame time.
segments.contextAfter: A low-performing frame rate can cause an app to seem sluggish or disruptive to its users, so it’s important to remove temporary interruptions, or *stutters*, to optimize your app’s user experience.
